    int res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (ll)res * a % MOD;
        a = (ll)a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }

        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;

    for (int sz = 0; sz <= n; ++sz) {

                ids[sz][mask] = (int)subs[sz].size();
                subs[sz].push_back(mask);
